name: HC-05 Bluetooth Classic serial module
description: Bluetooth SPP serial link (default 9600 baud, PIN 1234) for boards without wireless.
notes: VCC accepts 3.6-6 V thanks to the carrier board regulator, but the signal pins are 3.3 V: divide or shift the RXD input from 5 V boards.
Wire TXD to the microcontroller RX and RXD to TX.
Pin order differs between carrier boards (6-pin with EN/STATE, 4-pin without). Check the silkscreen.
Classic Bluetooth only: iPhones cannot connect (use a BLE module or an ESP32 instead).

pins.name: EN
pins.label: EN/KEY
pins.note: HIGH at power-up enters AT command mode.

pins.name: VCC
pins.label: VCC
pins.note: Board has a 3.3 V regulator: 3.6-6 V in.

pins.name: RXD
pins.label: RXD
pins.note: 3.3 V input: from a 5 V Arduino TX use a divider (1 k / 2 k) or level shifter.
